profile.ja: 藤美学園2年生。孝の１歳上の幼馴染だったが、刑事である父親の絡む事件に巻き込まれ、留年したため同級生となっている。銃剣術全国大会出場の父親から薫陶を受けた槍術の腕前は抜群で、その外見とは裏腹に、個人の戦闘能力は高い。
profile.en: She is a second-year student at Fujimi Academy. She is a year older than Takashi and was his childhood friend, but after getting caught up in a case involving her detective father she had to repeat a year, so now they're classmates. Trained in spear technique by her father, who competed in the national gun-spear tournament, her skill is outstanding, and despite her appearance her personal combat ability is high.

text.ja: 初めまして、宮本麗よ。こう見えて学校では槍術部に入ってるから結構戦えると思うわ！　よろしくね
text.en: Nice to meet you, I'm Miyamoto Rei. I may look this way, but I'm in the spear club at school, so I can hold my own! Let's get along.

text.ja: 私のお父さんは警察官でお母さんも元機動隊って考えると、対魔忍の格好をするのも違和感がないかも……？　て、そんな事ないよね
text.en: My dad's a police officer and my mom used to be in the riot police, so wearing a Taimanin outfit might not feel that weird…? Well, that's probably not true, right?

text.ja: たまに授業をサボったりしてるって聞いたけど、あんまり不真面目だと留年しちゃうかも知れないわよ？
text.en: I heard you sometimes skip class. If you get too careless, you might end up held back, you know?

text.ja: 対魔忍で槍を使ってる人ってあんまりいないよね。折角だし指導して貰いたいと思ったのに……え？　やめた方がいいの？　そう……
text.en: Not many Taimanin use spears, huh? I was hoping to get some instruction… huh? You think I should quit? I see…

text.ja: そっか、蛇子ちゃんは幼馴染みなんだ……いつもいるのが当たり前みたいに思っちゃうけど、大切にしないとダメだからね？
text.en: So Aishu Hebiko is your childhood friend… you probably take her for granted, but you have to cherish her, okay?

text.ja: 対魔忍スーツって格好いいけどすごい身体のライン出ちゃう……激しく動いたら零れちゃいそうなんだけど、大丈夫これ？
text.en: The Taimanin suit looks cool, but it really shows off the body… if I move too wildly it might spill out—are you sure this is okay?

text.ja: あなたも部隊のリーダーとして頑張ってるのね。ふふ、なんでもない。ちょっと私の幼馴染みの事を思い出しただけ
text.en: You're doing your best as the unit's leader. Hehe, it's nothing… just reminded me of my childhood friend.

text.ja: 女心が分からない……か。じゃあ、女の子のルールを一つ教えてあげる。好きなのは、可愛い男と可愛がってくれる男。それだけよ
text.en: I don't get women… huh? Then let me teach you one rule: what I like is a cute guy who's cute and treats me nicely. That's all.
